question: Should OpenClaw retire these shipped root bundled skills now and designate Sherpa ONNX TTS as an officially trusted ClawHub-only plugin?
rationale: This intentionally changes shipped capability availability, upgrade behavior, official distribution trust, and support ownership; tests cannot determine whether that product and release boundary is acceptable.

options.title: Require migration and release proof
options.body: Add a deprecation and doctor migration path, verify replacement packages and Sherpa artifacts, then land the retirement as an explicit release change.

options.title: Accept the breaking release change
options.body: Land the removal without migration only if maintainers explicitly own the resulting unavailable skill references and support impact.

options.title: Split or park the branch
options.body: Separate independently ready Sherpa work and defer or close the broad bundled-skill trim until its product direction is sponsored.

recommendation.title: Require migration and release proof
recommendation.body: Add a deprecation and doctor migration path, verify replacement packages and Sherpa artifacts, then land the retirement as an explicit release change.

likelyOwner.reason: He authored the merged precursor slices and has the clearest recent ownership of the remaining decision surface.
